analysis_plan.arithmetic: exact decimal context (prec 120, Inexact and Rounded trapped); px/sz at most 20 integer and 30 fractional digits
analysis_plan.ex_post: one unit at the touch, zero fee, valued only when every role in the route has a valid bound settlement; otherwise the route lists its premise failures and carries no value

models.agnostic_six_state: states L,M1,M2,H,F0,F1 with B=M2+H+F1: conversions plus the contract-spec common mark; nothing assumed about B in the fallback state
models.fallback_zero_semantic: adds the semantic premise F=0, intersected with the F quotes (a positive F bid is a premise conflict)

analysis_plan.p6: consistent_at_observed_price if every role matches its expected 0/1 at the one observed X; falsified_at_observed_price on any mismatch; unavailable on any premise failure; a match does not identify the mapping at unobserved prices
analysis_plan.price_detail_premise: B, L, M and H must each carry details "price:X" and all X must agree; F may omit details or carry an empty string, but a present F price must parse and agree; a missing, unparsable or conflicting price is a premise failure, never agreement
analysis_plan.removal: classified only from a final outcomeMeta that parses with outcomes and questions lists, integer ids and no duplicates, and in which the long-dated control question 198 matches its frozen structure (book-gate meta check) with control outcome 1473 listed; otherwise unavailable
analysis_plan.settlement_binding: a settledOutcome object counts only if spec.outcome is the requested id, the spec equals the frozen canonical spec exactly, and settleFraction is a decimal in [0, 1]
analysis_plan.settlement_observation: observation bounds only: each read keeps its send and receive times and shape, and a valid bound object proves the record existed by that read's receipt; no protocol settlement lower bound is derived, because a null response is not proof of an unsettled state
analysis_plan.snapshot_gates: book-gate freshness, local window and server spread; Q371 and 7544 brackets unchanged at meta_pre and meta_mid

decision_rule.failure: Any stop (schedule missed, transport, HTTP, cap admission, truncation, deadline) keeps the retained members and terminal and accepts no projection; a killed worker leaves the fsynced pending prefix; the supervisor re-parses, validates the 30 planned records including schedule and clock fields, and reproduces the projection.
decision_rule.h2: no_violation if every usable snapshot is feasible in the agnostic six-state model; candidate if any usable snapshot is infeasible (separate fee, settlement-latency and depth review; no naked short); inconclusive if no snapshot is usable. One expiry gives no repeatability.
decision_rule.other: Settlement observations keep both read intervals and shapes; only a valid bound object is evidence, observed by its read's receipt; null never yields a settlement lower bound. Removal statuses (listed or absent) come only from a strictly parsed final outcomeMeta in which the long-dated control question 198 is unchanged and control 1473 is listed; otherwise unavailable; the control response shape is recorded without interpretation.
decision_rule.p6: consistent_at_observed_price, falsified_at_observed_price or unavailable (with every premise failure listed) from the 06:10 round; consistency at one price does not identify the bucket mapping at unobserved prices

draft_note: Root-reviewed fixed future schedule; source and this exact plan must be committed before one launch. Original draft retained. No retries, input substitution or post-outcome rule changes.
exclusions: No orders, signing, accounts, websocket, RPC, trades, asset contexts, tokenDetails, spotMeta, retries or alternative endpoints. No rolling/news data.
questions: H2 near expiry: valuation infeasibility of 7544 and Q371 in the agnostic six-state and F=0 semantic models (each conditional), from 15 YES l2Book snapshots
P6 at the observed price: do bound settleFraction values match index:0/1/2 = <84251, [84251,87690), >=87690 and B = 1{X>=85971} at the one realized X? A match is consistency at X only

Settlement observation: send and receive times and shapes of the two settledOutcome reads; a valid bound object proves the record existed by that read's receipt; no protocol settlement lower bound is derived
Absence of settled outcomes and question 371 from a strictly parsed final outcomeMeta
Response shape of settledOutcome for an unsettled control outcome (1473)

request_plan.bundle: one gzip member per record, written and fsynced to a pending file before the next request and hard-linked to the final name at the end (a killed worker leaves the pending prefix); a request is sent only if a worst-case empty record still fits; a record that does not fit keeps a bounded body prefix whose stored (level 0) member fits (bounded, not proven maximal), is flagged truncated, and stops the run as a failure
request_plan.connection: one keep-alive connection per scheduled group via the reused book-gate fetch, which retires a connection after any protocol-indicated close and counts every open; never a retry
